title: Fresh Fixture
statement: Implement `solve(reset)`. Two tests each append 1. If `reset` is 1, each test starts from an empty list, so the second test sees `[1]`. If `reset` is 0, they share a list, so the second test sees `[1, 1]`. Return `{"first": [...], "second": [...]}`.
hints: Shared mode uses one list for both appends.
Reset mode uses a new list for the second test.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A class-level list survives from test to test.

editorial: A class-level list survives from test to test. setUp that assigns a new list on self gives the second test an empty container. The two results are the leak and the fix, side by side.
